description: This file contains core request processing utilities for a proxy server handling language model API requests, including error parsing, streaming response handling, header management, and request lifecycle management.

classes.name: ProxyBaseLLMRequestProcessing
classes.description: A class providing core request processing utilities for handling language model API requests, including header management, error handling, streaming response management, and request lifecycle control.

methods.name: _parse_event_data_for_error
methods.description: Parses an event line (string or bytes) to extract an error code if present.

methods.name: create_streaming_response
methods.description: Creates a StreamingResponse, inspecting the first chunk for error codes to set the appropriate HTTP status.

methods.name: _get_cost_breakdown_from_logging_obj
methods.description: Extracts original cost and discount amount from a logging object if available.

methods.name: get_custom_headers
methods.description: Generates custom headers for requests, including cost, rate limits, and request metadata.

methods.name: common_processing_pre_call_logic
methods.description: Prepares request data and logging objects before calling the language model API.

methods.name: base_process_llm_request
methods.description: Handles the core logic of processing an LLM request, including routing, streaming, and response handling.

methods.name: base_passthrough_process_llm_request
methods.description: Processes passthrough LLM requests, returning streaming or complete responses.

methods.name: _is_streaming_response
methods.description: Detects if a response object is a streaming response based on its type.

methods.name: _is_streaming_request
methods.description: Determines if a request is a streaming request based on data parameters.

methods.name: _handle_llm_api_exception
methods.description: Handles exceptions during LLM API calls, raising appropriate ProxyExceptions.

methods.name: _get_pre_call_type
methods.description: Maps route types to pre-call types for logging and processing.

methods.name: return_sse_chunk
methods.description: Formats a chunk (dict or string) into SSE format for streaming.

methods.name: async_sse_data_generator
methods.description: Generates SSE data for streaming responses, injecting cost info if enabled.

methods.name: _process_chunk_with_cost_injection
methods.description: Injects cost information into streaming chunks if enabled.

methods.name: _inject_cost_into_sse_frame_str
methods.description: Injects cost data into an SSE frame string by modifying its JSON data line.

methods.name: _inject_cost_into_usage_dict
methods.description: Adds cost info into a usage dictionary for message delta events.

methods.name: maybe_get_model_id
methods.description: Retrieves model ID from logging object or request metadata.
